# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 c25 P10](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c17 P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** James A.  <sub>[v2 c25 P10](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0010)</sub>; J. A.  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pettifer is short in stature, heavy-set, and bald except for a small strip of hair encircling his ears. He has a circular countenance with bulging blue eyes. When consumed by fury, his face turns a violet shade.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021)_

## Personality

Regarded in Brierley as an eccentric crank, Mr. Pettifer is extremely candid and impetuous, insisting on always voicing his exact thoughts directly. Although prone to outbursts of temper, stinginess, and harsh critiques, he also exhibits a warm, hospitable, and friendly nature once appeased. He values honesty, holds resolute opinions, and takes a blunt approach to life and literary advice.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c9 P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v3 c12 P74](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0074)_

- Farming and harvesting crops  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c17 P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- Maintain a quiet, comfortable life on his farm  <sub>[v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 c25 P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)</sub>

## History

After moving to Brierley from New Brunswick and purchasing the Bell farm, Mr. Pettifer earned a reputation for eccentricity and housekept alone alongside his swearing parrot, Nutmeg. A dispute over a stray Jersey cow in his oats initially led to a confrontation with Nell Harcourt, but the two soon established a close friendship when she visited to resolve the matter with a peace offering. Following the death of Nutmeg during a lightning storm, Mr. Pettifer's estranged wife Emily arrived unexpectedly, prompting a reconciliation between the couple. With Emily managing the household, Mr. Pettifer became a tidier, more socially engaged neighbor, regularly attending church and contributing to village affairs. During Nell's pursuits as an author, he offered blunt yet constructive literary critiques and practical guidance.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P28](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0028), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c24 P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041), [v2 c24 P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 c25 P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 c25 P50](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0050), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008), [v3 c11 P50](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0050), [v3 c12 P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041), [v3 c12 P74](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0074)_

## Background by volume

- Originally from New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
